# Gameindustry — Sherwood is a Sure Thing

- Original source: [Gameindustry — Sherwood is a Sure Thing](https://www.gameindustry.com/reviews/game-review/sherwood-is-a-sure-thing/)
- Author / publication: John Breeden II / Gameindustry
- Language / date: English; 2003-06-02
- Access: Article text inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Breeden awards 4½ GiN Gems and finds the game demanding but substantially more forgiving than Commandos. The review praises the detailed 2D scenery, building transparency, and the need to combine complementary abilities.

Forest raids and their traps are a particular favorite. The author explains how nonlethal play encourages recruitment and creates a coordination problem: incapacitating, carrying, and binding an enemy before a patrol arrives.

Camp production introduces a separate tradeoff between taking a useful fighter on a mission and leaving that person behind to train or replenish supplies. This review's enjoyment of ambushes contrasts with other contemporary reviewers' complaints about their repetition.
